purpose: descriptive low-context catalog of execution options, costs, and related knowledge

cost_classes.local: no per-call hosted API fee; local compute and licensing still matter
cost_classes.included: uses a plan or credit bucket; verify current allowance
cost_classes.unknown: do not assume cost until verified

prefer: host-native PR/check-suite subscription that resumes the same session
notes: same-session completion subscriptions can reduce manual polling
GitHub workflow_run can start a separate automated continuation

priority_note: cost classes are descriptive; this array is not a required execution order

delegation_options.note: delegation is optional; the active agent decides whether it helps the task
useful_when: context transfer and setup are small relative to the work
caution_when: worker setup or context transfer dominates
trust or credential boundaries make isolation difficult
